changes.before: The complete 14-reaction KEGG M00373 ethylmalonyl pathway assimilates three acetyl-CoA plus CO2 and bicarbonate into malate and succinyl-CoA. All twelve mandatory orthology groups are retained, including both propionyl-CoA carboxylase subunits and the complete propionyl branch. Experimental protein scope is Cereibacter sphaeroides 2.4.1/DSM158, historically Rhodobacter sphaeroides; AM1 studies provide separately scoped route and terminal-chemistry corroboration. Mcl2 hydrolysis terminates the malate branch without ATP formation. The native MetaCyc PWY-5741 ATP-forming terminal ligase conflicts with this chemistry, so the two pathway identifiers are not exact-mapped. Native CPD-9409 has an older stereochemical conflict; current Rhea/ChEBI beta-methylmalyl chemistry is retained. The R-specific hydroxybutyryl-CoA branch follows the issued module and primary R. sphaeroides evidence; AM1's figure versus assay R/S wording disagreement is not silently resolved. Rhea's one fully reduced whole-ETF state is a formal equation; primary Mcd transfers one electron to each of two ETF molecules. D3JV03 exactly matches the deposited native 548-aa Mcd coding product; purification tags have separate construct scope; the 555-aa Q3J5V7 counterpart has seven extra N-terminal residues, with no processing explanation inferred. Reviewed Ecm/Mcd homodimer annotations, inferred PCC/MCM assemblies, alternative metal assay conditions and Mcl2's unresolved dimer/trimer are distinguished in evidence. PccR indirectly controls the PCC step through pccB transcription. Exact PhaB and crotonase protein assignments remain unresolved; this does not omit their chemical reactions. No upstream acetate activation, downstream TCA/serine reactions, engineered Mco chemistry or guessed regulator ligand is added.

changes.before: Stoichiometric coefficient 1. Whole ETF protein redox state in the formal Rhea equation. Primary R. sphaeroides turnover instead reduces two ETF molecules by one electron each; this is not a measured one-ETF microscopic step.

changes.before: Catalysis by the assembled enzyme. Exact sequence bridges and source-specific evidence tiers are retained in the research ledger. D3JV03 matches the native 548-aa ADC44452.1 coding product, not purification tags. Its UniProt taxon is species1063; the original protein/CDS strain qualifier is 2.4.1. Q3J5V7 has seven extra N-terminal residues and is not substituted. The Rhea whole-ETF equation is a formal abstraction of measured one-electron transfers.
changes.after: Catalysis by the assembled enzyme. Exact sequence bridges and source-specific evidence tiers are retained in the research ledger. D3JV03 matches the native 548-aa ADC44452.1 coding product, not purification tags. Its UniProt taxon is species1063; the original protein/CDS strain qualifier is 2.4.1. Q3J5V7 has seven extra N-terminal residues and is not substituted. The Rhea whole-ETF equation is a formal abstraction; observed Mcd ETF semiquinone formation is consistent with the cited ACAD-family mechanism, without directly measuring its two-ETF microscopic stoichiometry.

changes.before: Wild-type Mcd uses ETF as electron acceptor. Two consecutive one-electron transfers reduce two ETF molecules to semiquinones; engineered oxygen-using Mco variants are a distinct scope.
changes.after: Wild-type Mcd uses ETF and forms ETF semiquinone. The Introduction describes the ACAD-family mechanism as two successive one-electron transfers to two ETFs, citing prior work. This is consistent with Mcd observations, not a direct measurement of two-ETF microscopic stoichiometry; engineered oxygen-using Mco variants are distinct.

changes.before: Deleting pccR eliminated carbon-source-dependent regulation of pccB transcript and cellular PCC activity; complementation restored regulation. Soluble PccR purification failed, so direct promoter binding was not demonstrated.
changes.after: Deleting pccR removed carbon-source-dependent pccB transcript and cellular PCC-activity regulation. Complementation restored propionate growth and cellular PCC activity; restored transcription was not measured. Soluble PccR purification failed, so direct promoter binding was not demonstrated.

findings.rationale: All 14 directions are extracted afresh from exact original RDF directional/master links and master-side resources, then checked with all 50 chemical sides. Every single-direction mutation fails specifically at that comparison before accepted output. Bad original source, derived projection, side coefficient, input hash and runtime bytes also fail. Changes to an input or generated KGX after semantic checks fail before publication. Success binds every consumed direct/nested input and output; whole SQL originals are hashed before use and rehashed at publication.
